# 5 Towns Jewish Times

> > A comprehensive Jewish news and community publication covering Torah commentary, Israel updates, local 5 Towns news, and lifestyle content for the Jewish diaspora.

5 Towns Jewish Times is a Jewish news and community publication serving the Five Towns area of Long Island, New York. The site features news, Torah commentary, personal essays, advice columns, and community updates with contributions from rabbis, educators, and local voices.

## Key Topics

- Jewish News
- Torah Commentary
- Israel News
- 5 Towns Community
- Personal Essays
- Podcast
- Letters to the Editor
- Rabbi Efrem Goldberg
- Pesach/Passover
- Aliyah
- Jewish Spirituality
- Community Updates
- Advice Columns
- War & Israel
- Jewish Education

## Core Content & News

- [Homepage](https://5tjt.com): Main entry point for 5 Towns Jewish Times with latest Jewish news, community updates and lifestyle content
- [Articles Archive](https://5tjt.com/articles): Comprehensive articles covering Jewish news, Torah commentary, and community topics
- [Digital Paper](https://5tjt.com/paper): Weekly digital newspaper with Torah portions and community news
- [Advertise](https://5tjt.com/advertise): Advertising rates and information for print and digital placements

## Torah Commentary & Spirituality

- [Never Stuck In Israel: Turning Disrupted Plans Into Purpose](https://5tjt.com/never-stuck-in-israel-turning-disrupted-plans-into-purpose): Rabbi Efrem Goldberg's Torah commentary on faith and purpose in Israel
- [Wealth From The Broken Pieces](https://5tjt.com/wealth-from-the-broken-pieces): Passover reflection on freedom, redemption, and Kabbalah mysticism
- [The Need To Know](https://5tjt.com/the-need-to-know): Commentary on Shabbos observance and Israel news from diaspora perspective

## Personal Essays & Community Voices

- [Our Aliyah Journal: An Update During War](https://5tjt.com/our-aliyah-journal-an-update-during-war): Rabbi Heshie Billet's personal narrative on aliyah and Israeli life during conflict
- [An Unusual Week](https://5tjt.com/an-unusual-week): Personal essay on Jewish traditions, mourning, and family milestones
- [Missing Moshe](https://5tjt.com/missing-moshe): Memorial and personal essay honoring Moshe Hirsch's memory
- [More On The Weather](https://5tjt.com/more-on-the-weather): Personal essay on winter weather and local community experiences

## Opinion & Commentary

- [Between the Lines with Yehuda Honickman](https://5tjt.com/between-the-lines-yehuda-honickman-march-18-2026): Podcast episode with opinion commentary from Yehuda Honickman on current events
- [A Last Chance](https://5tjt.com/a-last-chance): Editor commentary on Iran, Israel policy, and Middle East geopolitics
- [Letters to the Editor](https://5tjt.com/letters-to-the-editor-5): Reader submissions with political commentary and community responses

## Advice & Practical Guidance

- [When Parents Want Their Kids Home During War](https://5tjt.com/when-parents-want-their-kids-home-during-war): Parenting advice from Rachel Tuchman on family separation and war stress
- [They Say They Stopped. How Do I Know If It's Real?](https://5tjt.com/they-say-they-stopped-how-do-i-know-if-its-real): Addiction recovery and relationship advice column from Jessica Steinmetz
- [Fire Prevention Tips](https://5tjt.com/fire-prevention-tips): Home safety guide from Woodmere Fire Department on fire prevention

## Community & Education

- [When Teachers Become Learners: A Breakthrough Year At PTACH](https://5tjt.com/when-teachers-become-learners-a-breakthrough-year-at-ptach): PTACH school feature on dyslexia education and teacher professional development

## Optional

- [EL AL Spokesperson Update](https://5tjt.com/el-al-spokespersonmarch-18-2026-400-pm): EL AL airline update on flight cancellations and travel restrictions
